blocks.raw: # Product (Old)
blocks.text: Product (Old)

blocks.raw: A **product** is an item your organisation sells. It includes details such as price, description, brand, category, and other characteristics like size or colour. Each product is stored separately in the system and can be organised and filtered in different ways. After creating products, you can use them to run promotions,  campaigns, etc.
blocks.text: A product is an item your organisation sells. It includes details such as price, description, brand, category, and other characteristics like size or colour. Each product is stored separately in the system and can be organised and filtered in different ways. After creating products, you can use them to run promotions,  campaigns, etc.

blocks.raw: ## SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)
blocks.text: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit)

blocks.raw: A **SKU** is the unique code used to identify a specific version of a product.
blocks.text: A SKU is the unique code used to identify a specific version of a product.

blocks.raw: For example, a blue shirt in size Medium and the same shirt in size Large are treated as two different SKUs. Each SKU represents one distinct version of a product and helps you track pricing, inventory, and variations accurately.
blocks.text: For example, a blue shirt in size Medium and the same shirt in size Large are treated as two different SKUs. Each SKU represents one distinct version of a product and helps you track pricing, inventory, and variations accurately.

blocks.raw: Every product in the system must have a unique SKU.
blocks.text: Every product in the system must have a unique SKU.

blocks.raw: ## Product attribute
blocks.text: Product attribute

blocks.raw: A **product attribute** describes a characteristic of a product.
blocks.text: A product attribute describes a characteristic of a product.

blocks.raw: Examples:
blocks.text: Examples:

blocks.raw:
* Colour
* Size
* Material
* Warranty
blocks.text: ColourSizeMaterialWarranty

blocks.raw: Attributes help you define what information should be captured for products. You can create attributes based on your business needs.
blocks.text: Attributes help you define what information should be captured for products. You can create attributes based on your business needs.

blocks.raw: Think of attributes as the labels that describe your products.
blocks.text: Think of attributes as the labels that describe your products.

blocks.raw: ## Attribute value
blocks.text: Attribute value

blocks.raw: An **attribute value** is a specific option under an attribute.
blocks.text: An attribute value is a specific option under an attribute.

blocks.raw: For example:
blocks.text: For example:

blocks.raw:
* Attribute: Colour
* Attribute values: Red, Blue, Green
blocks.text: Attribute: ColourAttribute values: Red, Blue, Green

blocks.raw: If the attribute is Size, the values could be Small, Medium, and Large.
blocks.text: If the attribute is Size, the values could be Small, Medium, and Large.

blocks.raw: Attribute values ensure that products use consistent and standard options instead of free-text entries.
blocks.text: Attribute values ensure that products use consistent and standard options instead of free-text entries.

blocks.raw: ## Category
blocks.text: Category

blocks.raw: A **category** groups similar products together.
blocks.text: A category groups similar products together.

blocks.raw: For example:
blocks.text: For example:

blocks.raw:
* Apparel

  * Shirts
  * Trousers
blocks.text: ApparelShirtsTrousers

blocks.raw: Categories help you organise products and make them easier to search, filter, and report on.
blocks.text: Categories help you organise products and make them easier to search, filter, and report on.

blocks.raw: ## Brand
blocks.text: Brand

blocks.raw: A **brand** represents the name or label associated with a product.
blocks.text: A brand represents the name or label associated with a product.

blocks.raw: For example:
blocks.text: For example:

blocks.raw:
* Nike
* Adidas
* Apple
blocks.text: NikeAdidasApple

blocks.raw: Brands help you group products by manufacturer or label and support reporting and organisation.
blocks.text: Brands help you group products by manufacturer or label and support reporting and organisation.

blocks.raw: # Managing products
blocks.text: Managing products

blocks.raw: There is currently no user interface (UI) to manage products. You must use the <Anchor label="Product APIs " target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/reference/product-v2-apis">Product APIs </Anchor>to create, update, and retrieve product details.
blocks.text: There is currently no user interface (UI) to manage products. You must use the Product APIs to create, update, and retrieve product details.

blocks.raw: For bulk imports, use the existing Product APIs along with <Anchor label="DIY templates" target="_blank" href="https://docs.capillarytech.com/docs/diy-templates-connectplus">DIY templates</Anchor>.
blocks.text: For bulk imports, use the existing Product APIs along with DIY templates.
